contracts.invariant: Publication attempt is consumed before the consequential provider call and cannot exceed one.

positive.given: attempts is 0 and final authorization passes

negative.expect: the second tool call is deterministically rejected

contracts.observable: per-invocation consequential tool-call count never exceeds one
contracts.gap_evidence: Current code consumes publication.attempts before run_structured, but the inspected path relies on prompt text saying MAXIMUM ONE TIME and does not show a deterministic per-tool-call counter inside the model session.
